questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (around 00:09), there are exactly three pens arranged in a row.

All three pens have their black caps at the bottom end. Although the rightmost pen is tilted, its cap is still at the bottom, consistent with the 'cap down' orientation of the other two. They are not flipped opposite to each other.
All three pens have translucent barrels and black caps. They appear to be the same model and color.
All pens appear to have their caps on. No bare writing tips are visible. They appear to be of equal length.
The board moves continuously from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their relative positions on the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The board carries three identical pens, all capped and oriented with caps down. The motion is smooth and continuous. The tilt of the third pen is a minor variation, not a flip or opposite orientation.
